summary: Validated the 'live change on customer display' feature end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass — POST /api/orders accepts and persists amount_received/change; WS cart.update relay carries amount_received/change/is_checkout_open between peers on the same tenant; backend emit 'order.created' includes amount_received/change to all peers. Frontend: opened two tabs (POS + /display) sharing the same auth context and drove the complete flow. Verified all 8 required scenarios: (1) cart mirror to /display, (2) live change appears on display when cashReceived >= total, (3) block hidden when cashReceived < total, (4) block hides when payment method switches to card/transfer, (5) ThankYou with change HERO shown after confirm, (6) ThankYou persists beyond 10s (no auto-timeout), (7) snaps back to CartScreen when new sale starts, (8) card payment ThankYou renders WITHOUT change hero. Zero blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: POSPage.jsx broadcast effect debounces cart.update by 120ms — acceptable for live typing; UI verified reactive to amount changes within ~1.2s round-trip.
CustomerDisplayPage.jsx uses thankTimerRef as a boolean flag now (was a timeout ref). Naming is slightly misleading; consider renaming to `thankStickyRef` for clarity.
POSPage sends order.created via WS in finishLocal AND backend also emits it on POST /api/orders — double emission is harmless but could be documented.

Backend /api/ws handler only rebroadcasts cart.update/cart.clear from clients; order.created is only emitted by the server on the HTTP POST path. Offline-finished orders rely on the client-side WS emission — verified functional in the tests.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed orders via POST /api/orders during pytest; no products were seeded (used existing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart preview from POS to /display is throttled by 120ms debounce; assertions on the display side need ~1.5s wait after any POS state change (framer-motion exit adds ~200-400ms). Do not use 800ms — false negatives will occur when validating that the live-change block hides after switching payment method. Backend endpoint POST /api/orders correctly serializes amount_received/change and _id is not leaked. The WS handler at /api/ws only relays cart.update / cart.clear peer-to-peer; order.created goes through the backend emit path.
rca of the issue: N/A — implementation is correct. Only pitfall found while testing was insufficient wait after payment-method switch (framer-motion AnimatePresence exit). Documented above.
